name: ci-doctor
title: CI doctor
description: Every 2 hours (worker on Claude Sonnet): diagnoses failures of the long CI workflow (end-to-end or integration tests) on open pull requests, says whether the pull request caused them, re-runs other failures once per commit and keeps one issue per flaky test.
notes: Needs PROFILE.md, CI workflows, to name the long workflow, its jobs, test step, artifacts and result files; without it the routine does nothing. Without the app's Actions write permission it still diagnoses and comments, and asks a maintainer to re-run.
